text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Kikuka Sho is here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan talks about how countless losses to Mejiro McQueen have pushed her to grow strong enough to compete with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, McQueen declares that she will run her hardest against Ryan, who has become a bona fide contender in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With their rivalry as intense as ever, the two racers head off to commence their showdown.
